business: The Law Office of Dr Mujahid Al-Sawwaf
summary: A Saudi law office with a Riyadh branch appears to lose international clients to a free builder address, a template footer and a thin contact path.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Weebly address, with a footer that says Powered by Create your own unique website.
findings.cost: A builder advert in the footer looks unprofessional for a top litigation and finance firm.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a branded footer.

findings.problem: No contact form or WhatsApp appears, only postal boxes, telephone numbers and an E-mail us link.
findings.cost: International clients expect to send a short enquiry in one step.
findings.fix: A short enquiry form and WhatsApp.

findings.problem: A Largest litigation practice in Saudi Arabia claim appears with no source, rankings or case examples.
findings.cost: An unproven claim gives way to firms that show rankings and results.
findings.fix: Cite rankings and add case examples.

findings.problem: The homepage appears to be a short block of text with no lawyer photos or names on the first page.
findings.cost: Clients hire people they can see.
